// Part of the Dim Factory web starter. MIT License: copy, change and share it freely.
// Everything the site says lives here, so the words are easy to change in one place.
// [Fill in: ...] marks a fact only the owner knows (a name, opening hours, prices, an address, a quote from a
// customer). Replace it with the real fact; never make one up. The README lists what is still to fill in.

export interface NavItem {
  to: string
  label: string
}

export interface Feature {
  title: string
  text: string
  icon: 'spark' | 'heart' | 'clock'
}

export interface Update {
  id: string
  date: string
  title: string
  text: string
}

export const site = {
  name: '[Fill in: site name]',
  tagline: '[Fill in: one line that says what you offer]',
  description: '[Fill in: one sentence that says what the site is for]',
  nav: [
    { to: '/', label: 'Home' },
    { to: '/about', label: 'About' },
  ] satisfies NavItem[],
  footer: '[Fill in: a short line for the bottom of every page, such as where you are]',
}

export const home = {
  eyebrow: 'Welcome',
  title: '[Fill in: the main headline]',
  lead: '[Fill in: two sentences that tell a visitor what they can do here]',
  primaryAction: { to: '/about', label: 'Find out more' },
  secondaryAction: { to: '/about#contact', label: 'Get in touch' },
  featuresTitle: 'What you will find here',
  features: [
    { icon: 'spark', title: '[Fill in: first thing you offer]', text: '[Fill in: one sentence about it]' },
    { icon: 'heart', title: '[Fill in: second thing you offer]', text: '[Fill in: one sentence about it]' },
    { icon: 'clock', title: '[Fill in: third thing you offer]', text: '[Fill in: one sentence about it]' },
  ] satisfies Feature[],
  updatesTitle: 'Latest updates',
  updatesEmpty: 'There are no updates yet. New ones will show here.',
}

export const about = {
  title: 'About',
  lead: '[Fill in: who is behind this and why]',
  body: ['[Fill in: a paragraph about you or your organisation]'],
  contactTitle: 'Get in touch',
  contact: '[Fill in: how people can reach you, such as an email address]',
}

/** News, events or other short entries shown on the home page (newest first). */
export const updates: Update[] = []
